tap_mechanism: 68010 program-space memory tap installed after frame 10, when init_adsp() has dynamically installed the ADSP handlers
observation: Direct taps in independent 600-frame no-input and coin_start title-path runs observe exactly one 68010 write to the ADSP data window: PC 0x02C20C writes 0xFFFF to 0x80BFFE. Neither run observes a 68010 read in 0x808000-0x80BFFF. This is a reset/initialization landmark, not evidence that the ADSP-side data map is unused or that gameplay traffic never reaches it.
confidence: MAME-CONFIRMED window plus OBSERVED-IN-TRACE 68010 initialization write; no 68010 data-window read observed in bounded title path
notes: The coin/start actions were delivered at frames 120/122 and 300/302.
The tap observes 68010-visible handler accesses only; it does not observe internal ADSP data-space accesses.
